services.subheader: Comprehensive healthcare for the whole family

items.title: Family Medicine
items.description: Continuous primary healthcare for all family members, chronic disease management, and routine checkups.

items.title: Pediatrics
items.description: Child growth monitoring, essential vaccinations, and treatment of common childhood illnesses.

items.title: Gynecology
items.description: Women's health consultations, pregnancy follow-up, and routine gynecological exams.

items.title: Dentistry
items.description: Dental checkups, cleaning, fillings, and root canal treatment in a comfortable medical environment.

items.title: Dermatology & Aesthetics
items.description: Acne treatment, skin concerns, and anti-aging solutions using the latest medical techniques.

items.title: Laser
items.description: Laser hair removal, skin tone correction, and scar treatment with advanced technology.

items.title: Lab Tests
items.description: Comprehensive lab testing including blood, urine, and hormone analysis with fast and accurate results.

items.title: Radiology & Imaging
items.description: X-rays, ultrasound, and echocardiogram using high-precision diagnostic equipment.

items.title: Physical Therapy
items.description: Rehabilitation sessions for sports injuries, back pain, and joint issues.

offers.subheader: Special packages and offers for your healthcare

items.title: Family Package
items.description: A comprehensive package for four family members including periodic checkups, family consultations, and 20% off services.

items.title: Full Checkup Offer
items.description: Complete medical checkup including comprehensive lab tests, imaging, and medical consultation at half price.

items.title: Skincare Package
items.description: Four skin care sessions including deep cleansing, exfoliation, and moisturizing under medical supervision.

items.title: Seasonal Laser Offer
items.description: Six laser sessions for multiple areas with a free consultation and special discount for new members.

items.title: Dental Care Package
items.description: Comprehensive checkup, deep cleaning, and teeth whitening at a discounted price including reports and X-rays.
